definitionZh: :volution-clock的CSS伪类选择器代表了能够发出声音的元素,如音频或视频,但媒体元素的音频量目前被用户"锁定".
sourceDefinition: The :volume-locked CSS pseudo-class selector represents an element that is capable of making sound, such as audio or video, but the audio volume of the media element is currently "locked" by the user.
